etsy.title: Taurus Zodiac Poster, Minimalist Zodiac Print, Taurus Birthday Gift, April May Birthday Decor
etsy.description:
A minimalist Taurus zodiac poster with the Taurus glyph, the April 20 – May 20 date range, and three traits: steady, loyal, and stubborn.

WHAT YOU'LL GET
• A physical poster print, shipped directly to you
• Available in 8×10 in or 11×17 in
• Printed on premium matte paper at 300 DPI

HOW TO USE
Frame and hang for a bedroom, gallery wall, or as a birthday gift for a Taurus (April 20 – May 20).

This listing is a physical poster print, for entertainment purposes only. Thank you for supporting a small shop!

competitorNotes: Taurus results are bull-head art, constellations, and gradient aura; April 20 - May 20 matches this poster.
Digital runs about $2-9 and framed about $30-43 in snippets; 'birthday gift' and 'personality trait' appear in titles.
Most single-sign Etsy results are digital downloads; stating 'physical poster print' separates this listing.
Minimalist glyph-only sign prints exist but are mostly A4/A5 printables; the common styles are constellations, gradient 'aura' circles, and illustrations.
Amazon zodiac titles spell out size plus 'unframed' and the room (bedroom, living room, office); 12-sign sets, canvases, and tin signs crowd the results.

research.notes: Listing pages were not reachable from this environment; evidence is from search results only. 'taurus zodiac poster' is the sign-plus-product phrase in competitor titles and the query run; sign tags use the glyph, dates, and traits printed on this poster. Birth-month phrasing follows competitors' month-based birthday titles. No priceRange: snippets did not separate physical, unframed prints from framed prints and digital downloads.
